<thought>To find a single‑step retrosynthesis, I will search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that can be applied to the target molecule and that, in the forward direction, break a ketone (or ester) and a C‑C triple bond – the functional groups mentioned in the hint. I will query only by the functional groups broken, leaving bond criteria unspecified.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C triple bonds"],
  "limit": 10
}</action_input>
